Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly interpreted the release date for "Week-End With Father" by applying inconsistent reasoning. While credible sources such as IMDb, Wikipedia, and Turner Classic Movies consistently identify 1951 as the release year, the Planner arbitrarily used a later IMDb entry (2011, related to a home-media release) as the release date. This approach contradicts the stated method of relying on the "earliest public release," which was established as the standard in step 5. By deviating from this standard and resolving conflicting data incorrectly, the Planner made a logical misstep that led to the erroneous conclusion that "Premium (Film)" was released earlier than "Week-End With Father," when the opposite is true.
